messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired (P3) — service=runtime-proxy-latency, region=us-west-2, alert=p90_latency>800ms, pd_event=PD123456

incident-bot: Alert details: grafana://d/runtimes/proxy?panelId=7&from=now-10m — auto-suppress=no, escalation_policy=oncall-rotation

maria: ack — oncall here, pulling p95/p99 and traces. anyone seeing errors?

trent: saw a short CPU bump on proxy instances ~3222222160 — CPU spiked to 92% for ~45s. autoscaler didn't react (scale_cooldown=60s)

maria: grabbing logs/traces now. running quick query: 
```
curl -s 'https://grafana/api/query?panel=proxy_latency&from=now-15m' | jq .data
```

maria: stack traces show a handful of 503s from backend-redis during the spike, KV cache miss rate jumped ~x3. not sure if it's pathing to redis or a transient network hiccup.

jess: @maria can you check if any deploys landed in last 30m? CI page shows a canary push ~20m ago but nothing at 10m.

maria: no deploys. I'm seeing retries cluster around 3222222130. sample log: 
```
[3222222132] WARN proxy request failed backend=kv-red-07 err="connection reset by peer" route=/embed
[3222222133] RETRY 1/3
[3222222134] INFO proxied ok lat=312ms
```

trent: that matches the CPU bump window. my hunch: short network blip to redis nodes caused increased miss/retries -> proxy CPU climbed due to retry loops -> latency alert tripped.

incident-bot: Page auto-resolved at 3222222245 (duration=33s) — metric returned below threshold (p90_latency=430ms). No further pages in the same window.

maria: auto-resolved. quick mitigation notes: we briefly saw elevated retries; network to kv cluster had a tail of resets. No full instance OOMs, no pod restarts.

luke: customer impact check — running sampling against requests from the window: ~0.02% of requests returned 5xx and most clients retried successfully. no large-scale customer-facing errors spotted.

jess: tagging PD incident PD123456 as "no-impact" and closing the alert run. adding note about debounce tuning.

maria: follow-up action items: 1) increase alert debounce from 3m->5m for p90_latency to reduce flapping when we see 30-60s microbursts; 2) add a short-term dashboard for KV connection resets by AZ; 3) check autoscaler cooldown to avoid missing rapid scale during short spikes.

trent: opened infra ticket INF-7891 to investigate transient network resets between proxies and kv cluster. adding connection logs and tcpdump from the window.

jess: I'm going to update the on-call runbook section "proxy transient flaps" with the checklist: check redis connection resets, check autoscaler cooldown, verify no recent deploys.

maria: acked and leaving this thread pinned to the incident channel for follow-up. handing off to next oncall for tomorrow: @jess will own follow-ups. :thumbsup:

jess: thanks — I'll own and triage INF-7891 tomorrow morning. closing the thread as auto-resolved / no customer impact.

incident-bot: Thread closed (auto-resolved) — summary: transient kv connection resets caused a brief latency spike, auto-resolved in ~33s, no customer-impact, infra ticket INF-7891 created; follow-ups assigned to jess and trent.
